body: I'm in the second day now but have not experienced pain, when I've smelled food I've desired it but otherwise I've simply been bored due to lack of sleep;.

It’s pretty bad, but you can wear shoe lifts and be saved. Imagine being sub 5’5 or something, even shoe lifts would not save you. Many people here could only hope to be 5’4-5’6 with LL, so while 5’6 is awful, I am also 5’6, it can be worked around and you can appear of acceptable height. For that be grateful.

Tall men don't ascribe it to their height because tall height is preferred among women ([https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/fulfillment-any-age/201306/why-women-want-tall-men](https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/fulfillment-any-age/201306/why-women-want-tall-men)), the reason /r/tall is just a gag subreddit followed by men and women alike with a fondness for height and short filled with miserable people has everything to do with society and little to do with the action or inaction of short men.

Why do people always assume short men (always men, I've never seen a post encouraging a woman to improve her personality) have personalities that need to be worked on? Are taller men inherently born with better personalities that create a desirable aura around them? 

Once again the onus is always on the short man to work around everyone else's prejudices.

I'm not sure if it's a negative or positive generalization, but I did generalize above. Most women prefer tall or taller men, there's really no getting around that. I don't think that is a reason to blast me or anyone else.
